topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers came this morning, a riot of colors spilling out of the vase like a whispered secret. Each petal summoned memories of sun-soaked afternoons and quiet, shared silences. No card, no note, just the blooms standing tall and proud, as if to say, ‘We carry the message, read us.’ I arranged them carefully, letting my fingers trace the contours of each leaf. It’s a language, after all, and I’m fluent, speaking it with the grace of someone who understands that some things are meant to be savored in quiet, unspoken moments. The room seemed lighter, the air almost crisp with a newfound clarity. These flowers, they weren’t just a gift; they were a gesture, a bridge to a place where words are unnecessary.
